name: casbin/yii-permission
description: Use Casbin in Yii3 PHP Framework, Casbin is a powerful and efficient open-source access control library.

suggest.yiisoft/db-sqlite: Required for using SQLite database implementation with yiisoft/db.
suggest.yiisoft/db-mysql: Required for using MySQL/MariaDB database implementation with yiisoft/db.
suggest.yiisoft/db-pgsql: Required for using PostgreSQL database implementation with yiisoft/db.
suggest.yiisoft/db-migration: Required for running database migrations via ./yii migrate:up.
suggest.yiisoft/user: Required for automatically retrieving current logged-in user ID via CurrentUser in middlewares.
